name: Eureka
legalEntityNote: Eureka is a Midea Group brand. Midea Group, Midea America Corp., Midea Robozone Technology Co., Ltd. and regional sellers can perform different ownership, website, product, compliance and service roles.
headline: Eureka ownership, vacuum portfolio and Midea manufacturing network
description: A source-backed profile of Eureka's Midea ownership, Electrolux history, robot and floorcare range, U.S. operating entity and model-specific manufacturing evidence.
metaDescription: Eureka profile: Midea ownership, Electrolux sale, vacuums, robot cleaners, manufacturing, channels and buyer checks.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Eureka, Midea or Electrolux. Midea Group ownership does not establish one manufacturer or legal entity for every Eureka product.
headquarters: Parsippany, New Jersey for the visible U.S. operating entity; Foshan, China at Midea Group level
founded: 1909 in Detroit; acquired by Midea in 2016

ownership.summary: Midea Group owns Eureka. Electrolux sold its North American Eureka vacuum brand and most related assets to Midea in December 2016. Electrolux's annual-report note disclosed gross consideration of about USD 40 million; the widely repeated USD 60 million figure was the business's prior annual sales.

leadership.name: Fred Wardell
leadership.context: Eureka's official history credits Fred Wardell with founding the company in Detroit in 1909.

productPortfolio.name: Robot vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: J-series and E-series robots combine self-emptying or multifunction docks with mapping and obstacle-avoidance features.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm software region, app support, dock functions, consumables and responsible manufacturer by model.

productPortfolio.name: Wet-dry floor cleaners
productPortfolio.positioning: NEW and FloorShine products cover cordless hard-floor washing and self-cleaning use cases.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Check solution requirements, roller supply, edge-cleaning features and market-specific warranty.

productPortfolio.name: Upright, stick and canister vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: A broad value-led range maintains Eureka's traditional U.S. floorcare presence.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Product origin and operating entity can differ across families, so verify the exact SKU.

productPortfolio.name: Carpet and upholstery cleaners
productPortfolio.positioning: Portable deep-cleaning products extend the assortment beyond routine dry floorcare.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm cleaning-solution availability, accessories, service parts and commercial-use limits.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: An official Midea V12 manual and declaration name Midea Robozone Technology Co., Ltd. and list Midea, Eureka, Comfee and obode trade names.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not generalize this multi-brand platform evidence to all Eureka products.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: FCC records for the Eureka NER J20 Ultra identify Midea Robozone Technology Co., Ltd. as the applicant.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the filing, model suffix and production version before relying on the record.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Midea Group provides broad appliance engineering and manufacturing resources, but the reviewed sources do not establish one universal Eureka factory.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify manufacturer, factory and origin on the exact product label and compliance file.

marketsChannels.evidence: Midea America Corp. operates Eureka's U.S. website and appears in U.S. terms, privacy and customer-contact information.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Do not assume the U.S. website operator is the contracting entity in every country.

marketsChannels.evidence: The current U.S. site sells through direct ecommerce and presents a broad assortment across multiple floorcare categories.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the seller, fulfillment party, warranty eligibility and return route.

marketsChannels.evidence: Midea presents Eureka in international product and exhibition materials, while availability remains market-specific.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify the authorized distributor and local service coverage in the destination market.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Eureka combines century-old U.S. brand recognition with Midea's appliance scale and an increasingly broad robot and wet-dry portfolio. Its diligence challenge is entity and platform complexity: Midea ownership does not make Midea America or Midea Robozone the universal manufacturer and seller.
